title: FloodConnect M8 shared definitions
description: Enums and small shared shapes referenced by $ref from every other M8 schema (jev_decision, emergency_card, policy_gap_record, trend_signal, layer_readout, sandwich_trace, household_declaration, advice, official_guidance). This file defines no top-level object of its own -- it exists only to be $ref'd. `reading`/`series` stay on the M7a branch (schemas/reading.schema.json, schemas/series.schema.json there) and are not duplicated here; reconciling the two schema sets is out of scope for M8 (see the M8 design note, contradictions C1-C13, resolved at the M7a merge).

s4.description: 4-state sign readout (ARCHITECTURE.md section 5). BOT = unresolved/unread, NOT the same as ZERO -- a BOT value maps to gate HOLD, never to a decided ZERO/GREEN claim.

colour5.description: founder ruling 2026-10-05: ปกติ/เฝ้าระวัง/เตรียมพร้อม (FloodConnect's own label, not an official agency tier)/วิกฤต/ไม่ทราบ. An empty/unread ring is UNKNOWN, never GREEN.

tag.description: The workspace-wide readout-not-truth epistemic tag used throughout this project's own conventions.

confidence.description: Ordinal, per floodconnect_model.sandwich_decision's own confidence values.

gate.description: The jev_decision gate (M8, new -- distinct from the legacy `licence` field below, which `sandwich_decision` already returns and which this gate does not replace).

licence.description: The legacy gate value floodconnect_model.sandwich_decision/one_decision already return under the key `gate` -- kept under `licence` inside jev_decision so the new `gate` (ADMIT/HOLD/REJECT/ESCALATE) and the old value can both be carried without one silently overwriting the other.

source_tag.description: OFFICIAL = traceable to a cited Thai-agency item in advice/official_guidance.yaml (source_class OFFICIAL_TH; url + retrieved_at + verbatim_th). GENERAL = traceable the same way to a general-practice item (source_class GENERAL -- Ready.gov, gov.uk, American/IFRC Red Cross -- never a Thai-agency claim). FLOODCONNECT = this repo's own wording, not yet backed by a parity row -- see advice/parity.py.

verdict5.description: The home-as-shelter stay-vs-go verdict (P-C, advice/home_shelter.py -- not implemented in P-B). Missing household input must give UNKNOWN_ASK_INPUTS, never STAY_PREPARED. An official evacuation order always gives FOLLOW_OFFICIAL_ORDER.

choice7.description: The jev_decision.choice.options vocabulary -- the first 3 map from colour, the rest from the home-as-shelter verdict (P-C). When a verdict exists it outranks the colour's own option.

kg_anchor.description: Exactly the keys kb.py:_kg_anchor / tools/kg/locate.py:locate() write into 'kg_anchor' -- local copy of the shape M7a's sandwich_readout.schema.json also documents, kept here so M8 schemas never need an M7a file reference (M7a is a separate, unmerged branch).
